title: Retryable serialization-conflict error
statement: The system shall return a distinct, documented retryable error code when a transaction aborts because of a serialization conflict.
rationale: Serializable isolation raises abort rates; clients must tell retryable conflicts from permanent failures.

acceptance_criteria.text: A forced write-write conflict between two concurrent transactions returns the documented serialization-conflict code to the aborted client.
Non-retryable failures (syntax, permission, constraint violation) never return the serialization-conflict code.
